name: Context and integrations
description: A context diagram the author draws, and a table with a row to describe for every flow or interaction drawn on it.

diagramType.description: The canvas type of the context diagram.

kinds.description: The relationship kinds that are integrations.

columns.description: The table's columns after the counterpart.

required.description: The columns a row must fill to be described.

perRow.description: A sequence per interaction row, as { "sequence": a sequence diagram type }, or null for none.
